item.title: I think the water park should be open at all times to Marion County residents
item.description: "When I heard there was going to be a water park in Marion County, I was so happy thinking about the one that shut down so long ago and all the children here in Marion would now have such a fantastic place to go and have fun. I did not know about it being closed to Marion residents, being a resort and all the other plans this water park had. Yes, I heard now that “if there is room, it is open to Marion County Residents” however, this is not what we need in Marion County." - A Dunnellon resident

item.title: We have lived in Marion County for 29 years and have watched Ocala become ‘mini Orlando’
item.description: "We have lived in Marion County for 29 years. It was before State Road 40 was widened to four lanes, and there was nothing commercially built before or after Stumpknockers. You could actually drive comfortably to your destination. Life was grand, it was about country folk, farms, and horses. It was actually referred to as the 'Breadbasket of Florida.'
